articles.title: Army-led joint op destroys 10 illegal bunkers in Manipur's Jalenbung Hills & Thoyee Heights
articles.summary: An Indian Army-led joint operation successfully destroyed 10 illegal bunkers in Manipur's Jalenbung Hills and Thoyee Heights. This decisive action highlights the armed forces' commitment to upholding security and peace in the volatile northeastern state. Such proactive measures are crucial for countering unlawful activities, maintaining territorial integrity, and ensuring national stability, demonstrating effective internal security management.
